title: Unit 1 Consolidation: Language as Worldview: Humboldt, Kosztolányi & Cognitive Linguistics

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can sum up how Humboldt, Kosztolányi and cognitive linguists wrote about language and thought.
I can use the words for linguistic relativity and for keeping a language alive.
I can write a short reflection on the role of Hungarian in thinking and culture.
